name: Force Mastery Wizard Subschool
body:
Associated School: Evocation

Replacement Powers: The following school powers replace the intense spells and elemental wall powers of the evocation school.

Force Mastery (Su)

Whenever you cast a spell with the force descriptor, you gain a +2 competence bonus on attack rolls with the spell, a +2 increase to the armor bonus provided, and a +1 bonus per damage die to the force damage dealt. If the spell does not deal damage in dice, the spell deals 1 additional force damage.

Force Missile

The force missile ability provided by the evocation school acts as normal and continues to add 1/2 your class level to the damage (minimum +1) even though they do not have the intense spells ability.

Force Control (Su)

At 8th level, you gain much more control over force spells. A number of times per day equal to 3 + your Intelligence modifier, you can add the benefits of Extend Spell to any spell you cast with the force descriptor without increasing the spell’s slot-level or casting time. You do not need the Extend Spell feat to gain this benefit but the effect of this ability does not stack with a use of the feat. Additionally, as an immediate action you can expend a use of this ability to subtract your class level from all force damage taken until the beginning of your next turn. If hit with multiple effects, like magic missiles, you only ignore up to your class level. For example, a 10th level wizard with this subschool could ignore up to 10 force damage. If they are hit with 4 magic missiles that deal 4, 3, 2, and 5 damage. The total damage dealt is 14 damage, so the wizard would only take 4 of that damage and any force damage taken from that point until the beginning of their next turn would be taken as normal.
